prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [home, new_flow] Interactive Desktop Pet Feeding Mini-Flow: Adds an interactive snack feeding activity sub-flow while waiting for desktop pet generation.
   config: {"waiting": {"headline": "Your Pet is Getting Ready!", "body": "Feed your pet snacks while your desktop environment compiles."}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_feeding_flow", "home_intro"]}
1: [sign_in, reorder] Shift Sign-In Step Right Before Final Home Introduction: Moves the sign-in step to occur after waiting pet generation completes, right before final desktop introduction.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "sign_in", "home_intro"]}
2: [adoption, redesign] Stage Layout Redesign for Companion Selection: Redesigns the pet selection screen into an immersive interactive stage layout with full-size preview cards.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "stage", "headline": "Choose Your Perfect Desktop Companion", "body": "Select a friend to join you on your desktop workspace.", "show_step_counter": true}}
3: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Shortcut & Controls Intro Screen: Adds a new interactive shortcut control orientation screen before entering the main desktop intro.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Welcome to Your Desktop Pet Workspace!", "body": "Your pet is now active on your desktop."}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_pet_shortcut_guide", "home_intro"]}
4: [home, wait_info] Background Render Progress Breakdown & Timer: Displays live rendering progress breakdown with explicit estimated time remaining on the waiting screen.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_progress": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "hint": "Compiling 3D desktop assets and behaviors..."}}
5: [sign_in, copy] Account Pet Recovery Clarification Copy: Updates sign-in headline and body copy to clearly explain that signing in restores missing pets and account data.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Sign In to Restore Your Saved Pets & Purchases", "body": "Log into your account to automatically load existing desktop pets, customizations, and settings."}}
6: [home, notification] Desktop Ready Notification Switch: Enables a system tray desktop notification toggle on the waiting screen when asset preparation finishes.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "body": "You can minimize this window. We'll alert you on your desktop as soon as your pet is ready!"}}
7: [adoption, new_flow] Interactive Pet Personality Matching Quiz Flow: Adds an interactive personality quiz mini-flow before pick_friend to help recommend suitable pet archetypes.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"headline": "Your Recommended Desktop Friends", "body": "Based on your quiz answers, here are the best companion matches for your workflow."}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "new_personality_quiz", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
8: [finish, incentive] Bonus Desktop Wallpaper Pack Incentive: Offers a free downloadable desktop wallpaper theme pack upon completing onboarding on the home intro screen.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Setup Complete! Claim Your Free Desktop Wallpapers", "body": "Your pet is live! Enjoy your exclusive custom desktop wallpaper gift bundle."}}
9: [choose_path, hint] Path Flexibility Reassurance Hint: Adds a hint on path selection reassuring users that chosen playstyles can be altered anytime later.
   config: {"choose_path": {"hint": "Don't worry — you can easily change your path settings or switch companions anytime in desktop preferences."}}

verdicts.reason: Adding an interactive sub-flow while waiting is an allowed addition inside onboarding.
Reordering the sign-in step to occur after waiting is explicitly allowed by rule 4.
Redesigning the pet selection layout while preserving its core function is allowed under rule 2 and 4.
Adding a new orientation guide screen before the home introduction is permitted.
Displaying rendering progress and an estimated time for a real wait is allowed.
Updating sign-in copy to clarify account data restoration is allowed.
Adding a desktop notification toggle on the waiting screen is permitted under rule 4.
Adding a personality quiz sub-flow before companion selection is allowed.
Onboarding copy cannot mention free extras or gifts.
Adding reassurance copy regarding path flexibility on choose_path is permitted.
